This is a wake-up call for us to finally decide what kind of society we want to be. Do we want happy kids fighting for their own dreams—even if those dreams don't fit our personal taste—or kids drowning in despair, driven to the absolute edge?
For me, a true role model has nothing to do with personal preferences. It doesn't matter if you’re different as a person. What actually counts, what we should really look up to and admire, is the kindness someone radiates, their honest hustle to make it, and the strength to never give up on their dreams. That is what a real role model looks like.
Best of luck, Akylas! From the streets to the very top, your kindness and your struggle are already a massive victory.
